$docs.schemaVersion: Version of this blueprint's contract; packages/module-kit's parseIndustryBlueprint rejects a blueprint it cannot validate.
$docs.key: Stable industry slug, matching this folder's name; onboarding intake references it.
$docs.vocabulary: Labels for the shared domain nouns (catalog/folder/offering/resource). A blueprint changes labels only, never behavior; extra labels are allowed.
$docs.recommendedModules: Optional. Module keys a tenant of this industry is seeded with at onboarding -- recommendations, not hard-coded UI behavior. The always-on core (tenancy, RBAC, configuration, offline core) is implicit and never listed. Each key must match ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ with no repeats; keys become the registry keys under packages/modules/*.
